method: Live Walmart product pages read in Brad's Chrome, store context Omaha L St Supercenter / ships-to Omaha 68137. Positive in-store tell taken as a STORE-LEVEL availability line (e.g. 'Pickup As soon as 6pm today', 'Out of stock at Omaha L St Supercenter / Available for pickup nearby'). A page showing only 'Ships to Omaha, 68137' with Pickup 'Check nearby' or 'Get it nearby' and Delivery 'Not available' was treated as ship-only (FC), not shelf. No CAPTCHA or bot wall was encountered on any of the 21 probes.
